character.name: 虎豹重骑 / Tiger Leopard heavy cavalry
character.desc: Stout mature moustached cavalryman, large dark iron helmet with tall red crest and cheek guards, heavy black and bronze lamellar armor and broad red scarf. Mounted on a powerful broad brown warhorse with dark iron frontal barding and armored neck. Thick long heavy lance. Broad imposing silhouette.
character.special: powerful armored charge, rider braces lance, heavy horse plants then drives forward

visual_review: Selected after full-source visual inspection; exported idle, move, attack, special and independent head subsequently inspected. All body frames independently drawn; hit reuses reviewed idle poses.
